title: Infinite Snow Globe
description: A surreal scene features a large transparent snow globe on a cracked stone platform. Inside the globe is a multi-faced humanoid figure with four smiling heads stacked vertically, a mechanical torso with a large pink rose on its chest, and hands holding a smaller snow globe containing a tiny version of the same scene. Pink petals float throughout. In the background, a green kitchen with an open yellow refrigerator containing repeating smaller scenes stands next to a large stained glass window depicting a silhouetted figure walking toward a red celestial body under a dark, cracked sky with floating petals.
